# mshta.exe is all Rust (mshta-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mshta-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mshta-rust/src/mshta/main.rs)
add_cargo_module(mshta mshta-cargo mshta.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE mshta-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
